posts.author: The Joker
posts.title: The Inzerillos
posts.edited: Last Edit: August 15, 2009, 10:09:34 PM by [NtN]National Shark
posts.html:
Dabbing sweat off his forehead, he stares down at his desk. Staring at the desert eagle, ears popping, guns exploding, men falling. Quickly he pops around the corner shooting one of the raiders trying to gain control of the compound. All around the raiders, more, and more the raiders quickly get out numbered. Being pushed back into a corner of death, a man stands gets up. Reloading his pistol, and fiddling with it. He quickly stares at the last of the raiders speaking in a heartless tone, "So you've chosen to attack the Inzerillos? What makes you think that we would have so little of people? We prefer to use tactics, then people like you. Who enjoy the heat of battle, watching blood fall..." The last of the raiders, cower, begging not to be killed even though they know it's to late. "Please! Please spare my life! I'll help you get them back! I'll give you anything!!!" One of the raiders start kissing The Don's shoe. The Don stares down at him, "You make me sick you filthy rat! Your the lowest kind of person I would want in my family... Go jump off a bridge, and hit hell...
He holds the pistol to that low life's head, staring down at him with vengeful eyes, The Don speaks, it's like time slows down perfectly... The bullet slowly bursts out, with the man begging for his life... For the last time, would he ever live.
Thud, nothing else... The body lays there motionless, while The Don stares him. He puts his gun away, and walks off... Following the path of darkness, where light can never reach.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

And we'll see if your loyal enough to stay with us, I don't want people who switch clans often. If you join, know that it's like a contract. If you leave, MAKE SURE YOU POST IT UP! If not, then maybe something might happen. I'm screwing with ya but seriously.
